## Prototype Dual-Metric Sweep

This is a lightweight prototype to compare metric behavior before wiring full Snakemake inference.

```{python}
#| label: prototype-sweep
def simple_kernel(beta: float, kmax: int) -> np.ndarray:
    nu = np.arange(1, kmax + 1, dtype=float)
    return 1.0 - (1.0 - beta) ** nu

#jeello
def beta_from_r0(r0: float, gamma: float, avg_degree: float) -> float:
    return float(np.clip((r0 * gamma) / avg_degree, 1e-6, 1.0 - 1e-6))


def mix_kernels_blockwise(
    n: int,
    kmax: int,
    omega: float,
    c1: np.ndarray,
    c2: np.ndarray,
    rng: np.random.Generator,
) -> np.ndarray:
    kernels = np.zeros((n, kmax), dtype=float)
    split = n // 2
    draws = rng.random(n)
    for i in range(n):
        if i < split:
            kernels[i] = c1 if draws[i] >= omega else c2
        else:
            kernels[i] = c2 if draws[i] >= omega else c1
    return kernels


def fit_best_simple_beta(kernel: np.ndarray, grid_size: int = 2000) -> tuple[float, np.ndarray]:
    k = kernel.shape[0]
    beta_grid = np.linspace(1e-6, 1.0 - 1e-6, grid_size)
    nu = np.arange(1, k + 1, dtype=float)
    candidates = 1.0 - np.power((1.0 - beta_grid[:, None]), nu[None, :])
    l1 = np.mean(np.abs(candidates - kernel[None, :]), axis=1)
    idx = int(np.argmin(l1))
    beta_hat = float(beta_grid[idx])
    return beta_hat, candidates[idx]
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-dual-heatmap
#| fig-cap: "Heatmaps comparing L1 and Mahalanobis complexity metrics over epsilon and omega."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

if not df_metrics.empty:
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(18, 5), constrained_layout=True)
    
    # 1. L1 Mean
    # Use pivot_table to handle potential duplicates safely
    pivot_l1 = df_metrics.pivot_table(index="omega", columns="epsilon", values="l1_mean", aggfunc="mean")
    sns.heatmap(pivot_l1, ax=axes[0], cmap="viridis", annot=False)
    axes[0].set_title("L1 Complexity (Mean)")
    axes[0].invert_yaxis()
    
    # 2. Mahalanobis Non-Centrality
    pivot_mahal = df_metrics.pivot_table(index="omega", columns="epsilon", values="mahal_non_centrality", aggfunc="mean")
    sns.heatmap(pivot_mahal, ax=axes[1], cmap="viridis", annot=False)
    axes[1].set_title("Mahalanobis Non-Centrality")
    axes[1].invert_yaxis()

    # 3. Scatter Comparison
    sns.scatterplot(
        data=df_metrics, 
        x="l1_mean", 
        y="mahal_non_centrality", 
        hue="epsilon", 
        size="omega", 
        ax=axes[2], 
        palette="viridis",
        sizes=(20, 200)
    )
    axes[2].set_title("L1 vs Mahalanobis")
    
    # Save figure
    plt.savefig("l1_mahalanobis_heatmap.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.savefig("l1_mahalanobis_heatmap.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
    
    plt.show()
else:
    print("No data available to plot.")
```
